full_prompt_en: A square black-and-white photographic collage presents a close-up of a contemplative man's face divided into adjoining rectangular fragments against deep black. The upper left is mostly darkness, from which one brightly lit eye and a strong brow emerge. Near the center, a vertical seam divides the main face from a narrower, softer facial fragment that appears set farther back. His other eye, nose, and mouth extend across the lower and right portions in mismatched tonal planes, as though several exposures had been fitted together. A hand enters along the lower edge, fingertips resting against the lips and chin in a quiet thinking gesture. The face looks outward and slightly upward, but the broken alignment prevents a simple, stable portrait. Hard straight borders and a few thin horizontal seams interrupt the organic curves of skin, hair, and fingers. Bright silver highlights sit on the forehead, eyes, and fingertips, while the outer contours dissolve quickly into charcoal shadow. The background offers no room or landscape; its near-black field isolates the features and makes the joins between fragments especially visible. Fine photographic grain and slight softness in the inserted planes suggest printed film rather than a clean digital graphic. Strong side light from the upper left carves the brow and cheek, and the lower hand remains less brightly illuminated. The limited tonal range moves abruptly between pale gray and black, with almost no middle-gray setting to soften the mood. The overall composition turns a single introspective face into a tense arrangement of light, shadow, and interrupted identity.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形黑白摄影拼贴呈现一张沉思男子的面部特写，面容被分成相接的矩形碎片，背景深黑。左上方大部分沉在黑暗中，一只受强光照亮的眼睛和突出的眉骨从中浮现。中央附近一条竖向接缝把主要面容与一块更窄、更柔软、仿佛位于后方的面部片段分开。另一只眼、鼻子和嘴在下部及右部不同色调平面上延伸，仿佛几次曝光被拼合在一起。一只手从下缘进入，指尖贴在唇边和下巴，形成安静思考的动作。面部向外并略向上看，但断裂的对齐方式阻止它成为稳定简单的肖像。坚硬直边和几条细水平接缝打断皮肤、头发与手指的有机曲线。银亮高光落在额头、眼睛和指尖，外轮廓则很快消失在炭色阴影中。背景没有房间或风景；近黑色域隔离五官，也让碎片接合处格外显眼。细微摄影颗粒和插入平面的轻微柔化暗示印相胶片，而非干净的数字图形。强侧光从左上方刻出眉骨与脸颊，下方的手受光较弱。有限灰阶在浅灰与黑色之间骤然转换，几乎没有中灰环境来缓和气氛。整体构图把一张内省面容变成光、影和被打断的身份感所构成的紧张排列。
style_prompt_en: The image has a gritty black-and-white photographic collage finish, built from high-contrast tonal fragments and visible straight-edged joins. Pale silver highlights cut into broad charcoal and near-black areas; midtones survive mainly in textured focal planes. Fine grain, slight blur, and uneven print density keep the fragments tactile. Hard rectangular divisions oppose soft organic contours, creating deliberate visual instability even when the larger form stays readable. Strong side lighting isolates selected features while neighboring areas fall quickly into shadow. Close cropping and a nearly featureless dark field intensify the contrast between dense detail and empty space. The overall effect is spare, psychological, and cinematic.
style_prompt_zh: 图像具有粗粝的黑白摄影拼贴质感，由高反差色调碎片和可见直边接缝建立。浅银色高光切入宽阔炭灰与近黑区域；中间调主要留在带肌理的焦点平面上。细颗粒、轻微模糊和不均匀的印相密度使碎片可触。坚硬矩形分割与柔软有机轮廓相对，即使整体形体仍可辨，也造成有意的视觉不稳定。强烈侧光隔离选定细节，相邻区域迅速落入阴影。贴近的裁切和几乎没有特征的深色域强化密集细节与空白空间的反差。整体效果简练、富心理感且具有电影气质。
theme_en: A fragmented black-and-white close-up of a contemplative man
theme_zh: 沉思男子的黑白碎片化面部特写
name: Pier Paolo Pasolini
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
